about: What tools/clipping-check.mjs lets pass, each with the reason it stays (2026-11-23, stage 1). `match` is a regular expression on "idA/materialA <> idB/materialB axN+".

exceptions.reason: the nozzle sits inside its holder on the pump: 4 cm2 of faces, hidden by the holder's own walls
boxes of the same pump parts (holders, plates) with the same material: same colour and texture, nothing to see
undersides of the pump and bin bottoms on the island: they face down and are under the island's top, never seen
1 cm strip of the fridge's back panel against the sides, against the wall: hidden
tops of interior walls at ceiling height: above the ceiling, inside the slab, never seen
less than 1 cm2 of coplanar faces between small parts of the same object (phone body and keys, register, coffee machine, chair arm), same colour; not visible at play distance
the screen is 0.4 mm off the tube's face and drawn with polygon offset (lift): it does not flicker
two hose segments that meet end to end, same material
two white road lines crossing: same colour, the overlap cannot be told apart
undersides of the pines' stacked cones: seen only by looking up from under a tree, same material
cars' undersides and the roof cap of the cabin (same material): the undersides are never seen, the roof cap is one colour
